job.question: What questions are asked under section 10.0 'ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance)' of the NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund due diligence questionnaire (Appendix A)?
job.expected_facts: Eight questions: 10.1 the role of the respondent's internal advisory board(s), all matters referred to them (including unresolved ones) and any other governing/advisory bodies; 10.2 conflicts of interest (potential, current, historic) and how they are identified, managed, disclosed (e.g. to the LPAC) and resolved, including any conflict committees; 10.3 the policy on personal investments by employees or affiliates in deals the respondent reviewed; 10.4 whether the respondent is a registered investment advisor (RIA); 10.5 the respondent's ESG-related policies and how ESG factors influence its investment beliefs; 10.6 the implementation status of its responsible investment policy and any plans to develop its approach to ESG; 10.7 how it contributes to portfolio companies' management of ESG risks and opportunities; 10.8 the monitoring processes it would use to assess the proposed Fund's portfolio companies' management of ESG factors.
job.acceptance: Eight topics 10.1–10.8 required in substance, including portfolio-company ESG assistance and monitoring. Exact question wording and numbering are optional.

reviews.reason: The supplied document is a Cook County Manager of Managers RFP, not the NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund due diligence questionnaire. It does not contain the requested section 10.0 or its eight ESG questions.
